value: Peter Pan Preschool — Little Seeds & Peter Pan Schools

Peter Pan Preschool is a classic neighborhood preschool with a modern heart. Children ages 3–5 thrive in our structured yet playful environment, developing the confidence and skills they need to flourish in kindergarten and beyond.
Creative inquiry-based learning where children explore art, science, language, and social-emotional skills through guided play and real-world projects.
A structured kindergarten-readiness program that builds literacy, numeracy, and executive function while keeping the joy of early childhood front and center.
Daily outdoor learning in our school garden. Children plant, observe, and connect with the natural world, building science curiosity and a love of nature.
Extended care for enrolled families with guided activities, outdoor play, and a healthy afternoon snack in a calm, supportive setting.
